premises.text: Integrating house keys into smartphones enables a new sharing experience.
premises.evidence_span: Keezy integrates the house key into the smartphone to enable a whole new sharing experience.

premises.text: Smartphones are commonly carried and can replace physical keys.
premises.evidence_span: when you think about what you usually have in your pocket, it's your smartphone, your wallet, and...

premises.text: Keezy allows remote access to doors through a smartphone.
premises.evidence_span: the smartphone becomes the remote control for your doors.

premises.text: Keezy can open multiple doors without changes to existing locks.
premises.evidence_span: there's no changes at the front door downstairs.

premises.text: Keezy provides full control over door access anytime and anywhere.
premises.evidence_span: you have full control anytime and anywhere.

premises.text: Keezy allows users to pre-share keys with guests before their arrival.
premises.evidence_span: I pre-share a key with them before they arrive, so the key is in their smartphone before they arrive.

premises.text: Keezy enables monitoring of door access and sharing of keys.
premises.evidence_span: you can monitor your doors, who accessed when, and, of course, you can share.

premises.text: Keezy can be used alongside traditional keys or PIN codes for access.
premises.evidence_span: you can still use your regular keys or a PIN code to enter your apartment.

value.text: Keezy provides a convenient and secure way to manage door access.
value.evidence_span: it's really that easy to open a door from remote.

notes: No separate premises for the Indiegogo campaign offer as it is part of the sales pitch.
